Benefits & well-being

How we support the people who build Lattice & Spire.

Comprehensive health

Premium medical, dental, vision for employees and dependents. 100% premium coverage in the US; locale-equivalent globally.

Equity for everyone

Every full-time employee receives a meaningful equity grant. Refresh grants every two years tied to tenure and performance.

Flexible time off

Unlimited PTO with a 20-day minimum. Two company-wide weeks closed each year (early July, late December).

Hybrid & remote eligible

Most roles are hybrid (3 days/week in office) or remote-eligible within the country of employment. Some roles require onsite presence.

Learning & development

$2,400 per year per employee for conferences, courses, books, and certifications. Unlimited access to internal craft sessions.

Family leave

16 weeks of paid leave for all parents, regardless of role or path to parenthood. Phased re-entry supported.

Retirement & savings

401(k) with 5% matching, no vesting period. EU country-equivalent pension contributions. Financial-planning stipend.

Volunteer days

Four paid volunteer days per year. Lattice & Spire matches charitable donations up to $2,000 per employee per year.

Inside Lattice Engineering

Hard problems, low ceremony, strong opinions.

Lattice Engineering operates with small, end-to-end teams (typically 4-6 engineers per service line) who own their roadmaps, their on-call, and their relationship with the customers using their service. We invest deeply in tooling, testing, and observability — and we hire engineers who have strong opinions about what good looks like.

"This is the first company I have worked at where data-engineering is treated as a first-class craft, not an afterthought to the application teams. The infrastructure is mature, the standards are high, and the customer problems are genuinely interesting."
Aravind K. — Staff Data Engineer, Chicago (joined 2022)
"What surprised me most after a year here is how seriously we take the operational practice of supply chain itself. Engineers go on customer site visits. We watch buyers use our software. The feedback loop is real."
Devika R. — Senior Product Engineer, Frankfurt (joined 2024)
